prompt: Evaluate $2\sin 15^\circ\cos 15^\circ$ exactly. Give a fraction or a decimal.
hint: This is a double-angle formula read from right to left.

hints.text: This is a double-angle formula read from right to left.

explanation: Recognise the shape $2\sin\theta\cos\theta$, which is the double-angle formula for sine.

alternativeExplanations.title: Why identities are worth memorising both ways
steps: You could compute $\sin 15^\circ \approx 0.2588$ and $\cos 15^\circ \approx 0.9659$ and multiply: $2(0.2588)(0.9659) \approx 0.5$.
That works, but it is slow and only gives a decimal.
Reading the identity backwards turns an awkward angle into one you know by heart.
